title: Annotatio III §.IV: Heshusius refuses Origen’s σύμβολα and Clement; the same stroke would hit Augustine, Ambrose, Prosper, Dionysius, Tertullian, Bede, Basil, Nazianzen, Theodoret (pp. 379–380)
pass_a_gloss: Heshusius denies that he assents to Origen, who names the Bread and Wine σύμβολα of the body and blood; he rejects calumniously Clement of Alexandria; he will pronounce in the same way concerning Augustine, Ambrose, Prosper, Dionysius, Tertullian, Bede, Basil, Nazianzen, who names an ἀντίτυπον body; concerning Theodoret, who says of the Bread φύσιν and μεταβαλών — pages 379 and 380.
pass_b_english: Heshusius refuses assent to Origen, who calls bread and wine σύμβολα of body and blood; he calumniously rejects Clement of Alexandria.

The same verdict would fall on Augustine, Ambrose, Prosper, Dionysius, Tertullian, Bede, Basil, and Nazianzen (who speaks of an ἀντίτυπον body), and on Theodoret, who says of the bread φύσιν and μεταβαλών (pp. 379–380).
source_text: Negat Heshusius, se assentiri Origini, qui nominat Panem & Vinum σύμβολα σώματος καὶ αἵματος; rejicit calumniosè Clementem Alexandrinum; pronunciabit eodem modo de Augustino, Ambrosio, Prospero, Dionysio, Tertulliano, Beda, Basilio, Nazianzeno, qui nominat ἀντίτυπον σῶμα; Theodoreto, qui ait de Pane φύσιν & μεταβαλών pag. 379. & 380.

choices.why: Melanchthon’s charge on Heshusius vs Clement

notes: Heshusius vs Origen/Clement and cascade of Fathers; Melanchthon Consilia pp.379-380.
